title: A renamed rep stays one row under the current name in the report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active staff members for this test at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B, so that the work order can have a different Labor and Parts representative.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have a work order for that customer with a labor line and a part, Labor set to sales rep A and Parts set to sales rep B, and invoice it today, so the invoice has a separate Parts row for sales rep B.
  • After that invoice, change sales rep B's last name in Settings > Staff and save.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today.
custom_steps:
1. Expand sales rep B.
  2. Open the work order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales rep B is listed under the new name.
  • The invoice's Parts row is under it, in one row group (not split into an old-name and a new-name group).

Step 2:

  • The invoiced work order still shows the representatives captured when it was invoiced.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R2: “The names captured on the invoice do not change afterwards, including when a staff member is renamed or deactivated. That is what the invoice stores. The report labels each person with their current name, as it does today, so a renamed representative stays one row; it shows the captured name only when the staff record no longer exists.”
  • S5-R1: “When a work order is invoiced, the parts representative and the labor representative in effect are both captured on the invoice, by name.”
